newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Reform Minister Ulm Spineanu started talks with representatives of companies which will be shut down or are in dire financial straits.
* The government will not take any step back in its reform programme, the head of State Ownership Fund (FPS) said on Monday.
* FPS's executive board will analyse on Monday the procedures for winding up 17 loss-making state-run companies.

* Employees at the Bucharest-based engine maker UMEB protested outside the government offices against the plant's planned closure. UMEB is on a list of 17 companies slated for closure due to chronic losses.
